start.text: (The map on the round table.) Karthik: trucks north from Yelahanka — out. Priya: the old Purple Line runs under HIVR — end it there. Suresh: the glass house holds — stay.

ask.text: (Rathore folds his hands.) Thirty years of orders. Not this one. (They all look at you.)

out.text: Karthik lets out a breath he's been holding since the hill. Priya looks at the map and says nothing.

end.text: Priya puts the taped bat on the table, on HIVR. Karthik looks at the door.

stay.text: Suresh nods once. Uncle puts the kettle on. Priya goes to the lamp room and doesn't come back for a while.
